newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD sale depends on STJ court.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD sale depends on STJ court.

text.p: The auction Tuesday of Brazilian mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) depends on a decision by the Superior Court of Justice (STF), Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said.
Kandir told reporters the government would argue in the STJ in Brasilia that there was a "conflict of interpretation" among lower courts on injunctions granted against the CVRD sale.
All the cases should therefore by judged by one higher court, government lawyers will argue, he said.
"We are confident about the STF decision," Kandir said.
Privately an aide to the minister conceded the chance of total success was still "remote".
The auction of 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares was due to have begun in the Rio de Janeiro bolsa at 1000 local/1300 GMT Tuesday but was delayed by a flurry of court injunctions.
Kandir said 110 law suits were taken out against the sale and 19 injunctions were granted. Of those injunctions, 16 were overturned.
